candidate.definition_en: The front part of the human body below the chest, containing the stomach and bowels.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني البطن أو الكرش. كلمة عامية شوية وبسيطة عن كلمة 'Stomach'.

senses.definition_en: The stomach or the front part of the body below the chest.
examples: The baby was sleeping on its belly.

senses.definition_en: The lower front or underside of something, such as an aircraft.
senses.definition_ar: الجزء السفلي أو بطن الشيء (مثل الطائرة)
examples: The plane landed on its belly.
The baby was sleeping on its belly.
The plane landed on its belly.
candidate.mnemonic: الـ 'Belly' يعني البطن.. افتكر الراجل اللي عنده 'Belly' كبير شبه الـ 'Bell' 'الجرس'.
